title: 6 Weeks of Development - its only the beginning....
author: Apathlessknown
selftext: Its been an amazing journey so far... woke up 1 night and had an idea... and started Developing... never done it before... not a clue... just a Man with an idea... This is Footprints - my classic Action RPG, inspired by Silver, Soul Reaver and a few others.... i've been using Claude to Document my Journey, and pretty much just someone to discuss my idea with. - nobody else gets it. There's alot can be said for a supportive voice... even if it is a machine.

comments.author: DazzlingPut3895
comments.body:
I’m honestly impressed for 6 weeks, especially with no experience; that’s not easy at all. The visuals look really nice overall.

I was a little curious though, do you plan on tweaking the readability a bit as you keep going? In the video it was a little hard to tell what was happening at times, mainly because the character and enemies blend into the environment.

Either way though, this is a really solid start and I’m interested to see where you take it.
